newsitem.title: USA: Manufactured Home to acquire communities.
newsitem.headline: Manufactured Home to acquire communities.

text.p: Manufactured Home Communities Inc said Monday it has entered a letter of intent to acquire a portfolio of manufactured home communities from partnerships affiliated with Mobileparks West for a proposed price of about $115 million.
The communites conmsist of 3,950 sites and are located in California, Oregon, Utah, Arizona, Nevada and Washington, Manufactured Home says.
The acquisition is subject to due diligence, partnership apporval and certain other conditions, the real estate investment trust said.
Manufactured Home shares closed up 1/8 at 21-1/8 Monday.
